scope: Common ecosystem capabilities; personal finance, Health and ChatGPT custom GPT product excluded.

sources.claim: September29 notes announce dots, Codex Cloud, Pages/Space, scheduled Sites, code review/security cloud work, profile and third-party plan features.
sources.availability: Documented rollouts; exact feature-specific plan, region and platform limits require their individual guides.
sources.observation_method: official page read with web tool in this audit session

sources.claim: A persistent assistant has its own cloud computer, ongoing/scheduled/completed work, behavior rules and pause/resume/reset. Local-computer access is opt-in.
sources.availability: Gradual eligible Pro rollout excluding EEA/Switzerland/UK; supported Business Premium markets; Enterprise beta disabled by default. Desktop/web creation; mobile conversation after availability. Limited US Pro SMS beta.
sources.observation_method: official page read with web tool in this audit session

sources.claim: Reusable prepared repository environments support isolated cloud coding tasks, controlled networking, vault/proxy secrets and continuation while the local computer sleeps.
sources.availability: Cloud coding documentation separates legacy integrations. This cloud code environment does not currently support browser/computer use; do not inherit that from dots.
sources.observation_method: official page read with web tool in this audit session

sources.claim: Connected apps have separate authorization, supported multi-account selection and authorized event updates. Installation does not authorize the account; disconnect and deleting retained context are separate.
sources.availability: Plan, region, workspace role and individual app constraints apply.
sources.observation_method: official page read with web tool in this audit session

sources.claim: Plugins can package skills, connected apps and interactive extensions including panels/forms/editors. Account connection and install are separate.
sources.availability: Local tools do not become cloud/mobile tools merely by packaging them.
sources.observation_method: official page read with web tool in this audit session

sources.claim: A scheduled Site owns its schedule and cloud run context; it does not use a visitor's connected accounts. Instructions can be reviewed and schedules edited or paused.
sources.availability: Publication and schedule journeys have separate permissions; only relevant schedule sections were read.
sources.observation_method: official page read with web tool in this audit session

sources.claim: Living collaborative documents support human/assistant edits, comments and sharing. Mobile is view-only; version history and edit/comment compliance export have limitations.
sources.availability: Beta Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise; Enterprise off by default; not available for CMEK/ZDR/HIPAA configurations. Individual guide limits take precedence over broader release-note wording.
sources.observation_method: official page read with web tool in this audit session

sources.claim: Persistent named bots have separate context/memory and can work together on a shared account cloud computer with browser/files/login state. Background work continues while the laptop is closed; authentication can need human takeover.
sources.availability: Documented desktop/mobile product; shared account computer state is distinct from per-bot context. One computer-use actor at a time is documented.
sources.observation_method: official page read with web tool in this audit session

sources.claim: Main/side conversations support parallel interruptible tasks on a cloud computer. Scheduled/event follow-up, editable memory, approval cards and selective notifications form an ongoing-assistant workflow.
sources.availability: Official product description; no personal UI observation or independent runtime verification.
sources.observation_method: official page read with web tool in this audit session
